```{python}
from pathlib import Path
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
root=Path.cwd()
while not (root/'.unaltraweb/computations.yml').exists():
    if root==root.parent:raise RuntimeError('Projecte absent')
    root=root.parent
plt.rcParams.update({'font.family':'DejaVu Sans','font.size':14,'svg.fonttype':'none'})
offset=np.array([-10,-6,-2,2,6,10]);means_x=np.array([60,100,140]);means_y=np.array([6,10,14])
fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(9,5.4),layout='constrained',sharex=True,sharey=True)
for label,color,mx,my in zip('ABC',['#006699','#b87924','#39734d'],means_x,means_y):
    x=mx+offset;y=my-.1*offset
    assert np.isclose(np.corrcoef(x,y)[0,1],-1) and x.mean()==mx and y.mean()==my
    axes[0].scatter(x,y,s=60,color=color,label=f'Zona {label}')
    axes[0].plot(x,y,color=color,lw=2)
    axes[0].scatter(mx,my,marker='x',s=85,color='black')
    axes[1].scatter(mx,my,s=120,color=color)
    axes[1].annotate(label,(mx,my),xytext=(7,7),textcoords='offset points')
assert np.isclose(np.corrcoef(means_x,means_y)[0,1],1)
axes[1].plot(means_x,means_y,color='#8a222d',lw=2,zorder=0)
axes[0].set_title('A · Cada punt és un habitatge\nDins de cada zona: pendent negatiu')
axes[1].set_title('B · Cada punt és una zona\nEntre mitjanes: pendent positiu')
for ax in axes:
    ax.set(xlim=(40,160),ylim=(3.5,17),xlabel='Superfície (m²)')
    ax.grid(alpha=.15);ax.spines[['top','right']].set_visible(False)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Consum anual (MWh)')
fig.legend(*axes[0].get_legend_handles_labels(),loc='outside lower center',ncol=3,frameon=False)
fig.savefig(root/'assets/img/generated/fal-lacia-ecologica.svg',facecolor='white',metadata={'Date':None});plt.close(fig)
```
